description: The Microsoft Enhanced Cryptographic Provider, designed for FIPS 140-2 compliance, is a software-based, cryptographic module. RSAENH encapsulates several different cryptographic algorithms (including SHS, TDES, AES, RSA, SHS-based HMAC) in a cryptographic module accessible via the Microsoft CryptoAPI.
